messages:
Emily (support): hi team — customer reports promo code accepted in UI (green check) via partner portal but balance still 0 and usage keeps billing. Org org_4589, user emily.cust@example.com. We got a webhook 200 from partner. Can someone help triage? @billing @sre

Jason (support-eng): thanks Emily. Can you paste the webhook payload or the grant id? also any request ids from the UI flow?

Emily (support): payload snippet below, grantId is 9f8e1c2b. partner_token looks like `partner_abc123`. UI shows "Claim successful" and we received partner POST 200.

```json
{
  "grantId": "9f8e1c2b",
  "org_external_id": "partner_ext_4589",
  "amount": 50000,
  "currency": "credits",
  "partner_token": "partner_abc123",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-02T15:22:10Z"
}
```

billing-bot: Webhook delivered to /webhooks/partner/redeem with status 200 at 2024-11-02T15:22:11Z, request_id=req_6c4f.

Rohit (billing): pulling ledger now. quick check — grant 9f8e1c2b exists but ledger shows `applied_to_billing_account` = "billing_009_old" which is NOT linked to org_4589 in our current mapping. looks like partner mapping used `external_customer_id` that maps to legacy billing account.

Rohit (billing): SQL I ran: ```sql
SELECT org_id, billing_account_id, external_id FROM org_billing_links WHERE external_id LIKE 'partner_ext_%' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5;
-- result: org_4589 -> billing_001 (current), partner_ext_4589 -> billing_009_old (legacy)
```

Jason (support-eng): that explains why customer doesn't see credits — credit applied but to a different billing account. Do we know when mapping changed? any automation that reconciled external ids?

Rohit (billing): mapping change happened during partner-migration on 2024-10-29. Partner integration still sending `org_external_id` that maps to old account. Two fixes: 1) manual reassign grant->billing_001, 2) run a backfill to move ledger entries. I can apply a manual grant to org_4589 immediately.

Aaron (sre): FYI I checked ingestion logs for ledger-ingest-lambda from 15:20-15:30 UTC — there was a transient 500 for `POST /ledger/apply` at 15:21:03 for request_id=req_6c4f but the partner webhook retried and we got a 200 later. That 500 would have left the initial message in a retry queue but that shouldn't cause mis-mapping. The core issue is the external_id -> billing_account link mismatch Rohit pointed out.

Jason (support-eng): steps to resolve (short):
1) Rohit to create manual credit entry for org_4589 equal to grant (50000).
2) Run ledger backfill to move original grant from billing_009_old -> billing_001 and mark original as corrected.
3) Add a short-term guard: if partner webhook `org_external_id` maps to a legacy billing account, flag for manual review instead of auto-applying.

Rohit (billing): starting manual credit now. I'll create ticket BILL-1342 for backfill and link runbook. Reapply CLI: `scripts/ledger/reassign_grant --grant 9f8e1c2b --to-billing billing_001 --note "partner mapping mismatch"`

Emily (support): please also let customer know I added a temporary 50,000 credits to org_4589 while you backfill. they were getting charged and escalated.

Rohit (billing): done — manual credit of 50000 posted to org_4589 (tx tx_20241102_manual_9f8e). Backfill scheduled and BILL-1342 created, ETA EOD. I've added a change to partner mapping docs to include the current external_id mapping table.

Aaron (sre): I'll watch ingestion logs during backfill window and unpause retry queue if needed.

Emily (support): customer notified and confirmed temporary credits visible. will follow up once backfill completes. thanks all :thumbsup:
